method: Activation-guided low-rank direct additions to internal transformer mlp.fc2.weight. Closed-form ridge solve on development activations only; no gradients or optimizer.
rationale: Development errors may be corrected by changing residual-stream directions inside visual blocks while preserving the existing classifier. Fit a small logit-margin correction through development activations, then measure exact nonlinear suffix behavior.
selection: Max selection accuracy, then lower development cross entropy, then smaller patch norm; unchanged baseline included. Final photo labels are not read by search.
scope: Internal vision MLP weights; text network, visual projection and previous classifier remain fixed. This is an experiment choice, not an application-wide restriction.
fresh_test_limit: 60 previously unused photos from the same inferred evaluation capture sessions; earlier frames/results from these sessions were seen. Not a fully independent new-job test.
